qs.q: What is the main purpose of this notice?
o: To tell students about a temporary change
To ask students to buy new books
To praise the workers for their effort
To introduce a new library teacher

qs.q: Why will the library close early this week?
o: Because the roof is being repaired
Because the teachers are having a long meeting
Because the books are being moved to a new room
Because Ms. Park is away on a trip
qs.why: 지붕 수리 공사 때문에 도서관이 일찍 닫는다고 했어요.

qs.q: The phrase "thank you for your patience" shows that the writer
o: wants students to hurry up
is angry at the students
expects students to feel a little upset
is planning a surprise party for the school

qs.q: What should a student do to get a book for a project?
o: Use the box beside the main door
Talk to Ms. Park before twelve
Wait until the roof is repaired
Visit the library after 3:00 p.m.
qs.why: 정오 전에 사무실의 Ms. Park에게 요청하라고 했어요.

patches.why: Original key (returning books is harder) is not stated: the notice says books can still be returned via the box; no reason is given for waiving late fees. Replaced with a stated-detail question.
